title: Small-bias construction resource bounds
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $[?m\ell[?m>0$. The constructed small-bias construction has $2^{2[?m\ell[?m}$ outputs. Its field representation size is at most its field preprocessing work, which is at most $2^{8([?m\ell[?m+1)}$, and its construction work equals the field preprocessing work plus $2^{2[?m\ell[?m}$ times one more than the row work.
